excerpts.content: I’ve removed this Friday’s meeting from the calendar. The next one is scheduled for 23rd May.

excerpts.author: poojaranjan
excerpts.content:
I’d also like to share an update about the new bot that automatically adds meetings to the calendar as soon as an issue is created on the ethereum/pm repo with valid instructions.

So, if there’s no concrete date or plan for upcoming meetings, we can consider removing all recurring future events. Once the group decides on a meeting and an agenda is opened, it will automatically appear on the calendar—and I’ll handle the livestream.
